major_findings: STT lacks immutable segment identity and timestamps, so delayed transcripts can be assigned to a newer overlap
STT-first arrival and final-after-negative can bypass or undo the overlap gate
VAD and legacy word modes lack one complete AND-based eligibility table
Gate overflow, timeout and final-below-threshold precedence are contradictory
Lifecycle commitment and transcript replay lack one exactly-once resolution claim
Output paths lose response identity and cannot yet prove local playout lifecycle
EOS can receive evidence and commit while adaptive classification is pending
Wall-clock delay after VAD start does not prove observed voiced duration
minor_findings: Pause/recovery defaults were exposed before their milestone semantics exist
Legacy key precedence, exact file inventory and verification commands were incomplete
